title: Benefits Manager
description:
### **Summary**

\#LI\-Hybrid  

  

Location: Hyderabad, India  

  

About The Role
  

  

As a Benefits Manager, you will be accountable for developing and managing a multi‑country benefits strategy, including benefit design and end‑to‑end operations. This role involves leading negotiations with benefits vendors and service providers, and making informed decisions on the implementation of new or renewed benefit programs aligned with local market benchmarks and the Novartis global benefits strategy.  

  

You will lead and develop a team of Benefits Experts to ensure seamless execution of day‑to‑day benefits operations, adherence to device governance metrics, and compliance with established standards. Driving process excellence through benefits automation, efficiency improvements, AI‑enabled standardization, and data‑driven dashboards will be key performance expectations and critical to career progression in the role.  

  

From a people leadership perspective, you will have managerial responsibility for maintaining strong partnerships with internal stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, and HR, as well as managing relationships with external benefits vendors and brokers.
### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and analyze the local benefit programs as necessary to ensure they are efficient, market competitive, attractive to employees, compliant with local regulatory requirements, and aligned with global benefit principles.
* Responsible for participating in local benefits survey and data submission. Analyze survey results, benchmark local benefits against the market data, and share findings with local stakeholders.
* Manage benefit policy/program renewals, vendor changes, and new program expansions with the support of the cluster benefits lead, local brokers, and procurement to leverage Novartis' global/regional purchasing power.
* Manage the global benefits database for the respective country's benefits plans.
* Support local \& global stakeholders in local benefit projects, i.e. new benefits implementation, global rollouts, M\&A, etc.
* Support local P\&O in ERG discussions to gather feedback on employee benefits programs.
* Submit changes or new benefit proposals for review/information to cluster benefits lead according to the benefits governance framework.
* Prepare periodical reports required for legislative bodies, external vendors, unions, payroll, etc.
* Develop and deliver training and consulting to the country organization on any benefits\-related programs \& processes.
* Manage the benefits admin experts on day\-to\-day operational activities and their performance.
* Act as a 1st\-level escalation point to employees, country P\&O head, and PS\&S teams.
* Work closely with P\&O PP and external benefits vendors to ensure that the day\-to\-day administration of the programs is operating efficiently.
* Train the admin experts on benefits SOPs, processes, benefits technology, etc.
* Prepares or reviews process maps with the help of Benefits experts.
* Thrive for process improvements and initiate related projects.
* Acts as a deputy and 2nd line of control to the cluster benefits lead.

**Essential Requirements:**

* University degree, preferable in economics, mathematics, accounting or equivalent experience
* Minimum 5 years of experience in managing employee benefits processes for large and mid\-sized organizations
* Should have managed a team
* Should have handled and worked on Benefits technology platforms (Darwin, Benify etc.)

This role will be based out of Gurugram.


The role holder will work in a UK shift of 12:30\-9:30 PM.


**Purpose of the role**


To support the business with the management of employee relations cases, in line with relevant policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. This includes providing professional advice, support and guidance to managers and employees on a range of topics (including Disciplinary, Capability, Grievance and Sickness), and investigating matters where required.

* Provision of ER advice on a range of topics, including reviewing and drafting of documentation, advising on process as well as potential employment / legal risk. Supporting directly where required, often with senior complex, and regulatory matters.
* Investigations to resolve employee complaints, grievances, and disciplinary matters and guidance on the completion of these, supporting managers and employees as required.
* Employee relations policies and procedures development, implementation, and maintenance, aligning these to all applicable laws, regulations and the overall business strategy.
* Production and deployment of ER training in coordination with our control partners with a focus on prevention.
* Production and delivery of ER metrics, sharing insights with stakeholders on employee relations issues and trends.

**Vice President Expectations**


* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: HR Specialist
description:
Startdatum: z.s.m.


Bij JINC geloven we dat ieder kind gelijke kansen verdient. Om onze maatschappelijke missie waar te maken, hebben we een sterke en goed georganiseerde interne organisatie nodig.


Daarom zoeken wij een HR Specialist die graag meedenkt over het ontwikkelen, verbeteren en borgen van HR\-beleid, en dit weet te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en een zorgvuldige uitvoering. Daarnaast voel jij je thuis in salarisadministratie en zorg je ervoor dat alles achter de schermen soepel en correct verloopt.


Heb jij oog voor detail, neem je graag verantwoordelijkheid en wil je met jouw HR\-kennis bijdragen aan een organisatie met echte maatschappelijke impact? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

**Dit ga je doen**


Als HR Specialist ben jij dé inhoudelijke expert op het gebied van salarisadministratie en HR\-processen. Je zorgt dat alles achter de schermen klopt en alles goed is vastgelegd. Je werkt nauw samen met je collega´s van HR, waarbij iedereen met zijn eigen specialisme bijdraagt aan een sterk HR binnen JINC.

* Je bent onder andere verantwoordelijk voor:
* Het verwerken en beheren van de salarisadministratie, bij voorkeur in AFAS;
* Borgen van correcte toepassing van arbeidsrechtelijke en salarisgerelateerde wet\- en regelgeving;
* Opstellen, actualiseren en beheren van HR\-beleid, richtlijnen en procedures;
* Beheer en optimalisatie van HR\-processen en administratieve workflows;
* Signaleren van risico’s en verbetermogelijkheden binnen HR\-administratie en systemen;
* Samen met het team denk je mee over en geef je vorm aan diverse HR\-thema’s.

 **Wat breng jij mee?**

* Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen HR en/of salarisadministratie;
* Aantoonbare ervaring met salarisadministratie en verschillende HR\-thema’s;
* Kennis van HR\-systemen; ervaring met AFAS is een sterke pré;
* Goede kennis van relevante wet\- en regelgeving;
* Je werkt nauwkeurig, analytisch en gestructureerd en bent beleidsmatig sterk;
* Beleidsmatig en analytisch sterk: je vertaalt inzichten naar concrete HR\-oplossingen
**Het HR\-team**  

Als HR\-adviseur kom je te werken in een gedreven en gezellig team van HR\-professionals. Ons HR team \- jouw directe collega’s \- zijn Fatma (HR adviseur), Aniek (HR Adviseur), Kelsey (HR Adviseur), Anouk (HR Stagiaire), en Joyce (Teamleider HR).


We werken twee vaste dagen op kantoor (Utrecht) en zijn ook regelmatig op andere JINC\-vestigingen door het land te vinden. We beginnen iedere week met een weekstart en iedere ochtend met een gezamenlijke dagstart.  

Je 200\+ nieuwe JINC\-collega’s zijn gedreven, gemotiveerd en houden van verbinden en samenwerken. Bovendien zijn we intrinsiek gemotiveerd in ons streven een inclusieve organisatie te zijn en blijven.

**Wat bieden wij jou**
----------------------

  

* Een impactvolle baan in een **inclusieve** organisatie. En een betrokken en energiek team dat samenwerking belangrijk vindt.
* Bij ons ben je nooit uitgeleerd: met een ruim **trainingsaanbod en loopbaanbudget** stimuleren we jouw groei.
* Een salaris volgens de cao Sociaal Werk. De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 7 (€ 3\.132 tot maximaal € 3\.290 bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur). Bij aantoonbare senioriteit en ruime ervaring in de functie is inschaling in schaal 8 bespreekbaar.
* Daarnaast zorgen we goed voor je toekomst met een uitstekend pensioenplan.
* Met een **individueel keuzebudget** van 17% kies je zelf: extra vrije dagen, een opleiding of een salarisboost.
* Een tijdelijk contract van 12 maanden met de intentie om voor langere tijd met elkaar het avontuur aan te gaan.


Je standplaats is Utrecht, maar je reist ook regelmatig naar onze vestigingen. Hiervoor krijg je een NS Business Card tot je beschikking.

**Inclusiviteit**


Bij JINC streven we naar een organisatie die een afspiegeling is van de samenleving. We moedigen iedereen aan om te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, seksuele oriëntatie, beperking of overtuiging. We kijken vooral naar wie jij bent en wat jij meebrengt.

 **Enthousiast?**


Ben jij enthousiast om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan de missie van JINC? Aarzel dan niet en solliciteer meteen door op de actieknop rechts van deze pagina te klikken.


In het wervingsproces, beginnend met een telefoongesprek, gevolgd door in\-person gesprekken op kantoor en het maken van een casus, krijg je de kans om je vaardigheden en enthousiasme te laten zien.


Sollicitaties worden doorlopend beoordeeld; bij voldoende geschikte aanmeldingen sluiten we de vacature.


We kijken ernaar uit om jou te ontmoeten en te ontdekken hoe je bij ons team past.


Heb je vragen over het sollicitatieproces? Neem contact op met het HR\-team.


Een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag is vereist voor alle functies bij JINC. De kosten hiervoor worden vergoed.


Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

**Meer weten over de functie? Neem contact met ons op**

Department: VDC

Job Description: As a BIM Modeler in the civil engineering domain, you will play a key role in the creation, coordination, and management of digital models that represent various stages of building and infrastructure projects. You will collaborate closely with architects, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate and effective project development. Your proficiency in BIM software and your understanding of civil engineering principles will contribute to the successful execution of projects.

​

Responsibilities:

​

* Develop accurate 3D models of building and infrastructure elements using BIM software (e.g., Autodesk Revit, Bentley MicroStation) based on project specifications, design drawings, and engineering data.
* Integrate relevant data, including dimensions, materials, structural details, MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) components, and other relevant attributes into the BIM model.
* Collaborate with architects, structural engineers, MEP engineers, and other project stakeholders to ensure interdisciplinary coordination and clash detection, resolving any conflicts in the digital environment before construction begins.
* Generate 2D drawings and documentation derived from the BIM model, including plans, sections, elevations, and construction details, ensuring alignment with project standards.
* Create visual representations and renderings of BIM models to help stakeholders better understand design intent, construction sequencing, and project progress.
* Extract quantities of materials and components from the BIM model to support cost estimation, procurement, and scheduling.
* Update and maintain the BIM model throughout the project lifecycle, reflecting design changes, field modifications, and as\-built conditions.
* Review and validate the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of the BIM model and associated documentation.
* Engage in regular communication and coordination meetings with project team members to ensure a smooth workflow and address any BIM\-related concerns.
* Provide assistance and training to colleagues regarding BIM software usage and best practices.

Qualifications:

​

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related field.
* Proficiency in BIM software, such as Autodesk Revit, Bentley MicroStation, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of civil engineering principles and construction processes.
* Familiarity with industry standards, codes, and regulations related to building and infrastructure design.
* Attention to detail and strong problem\-solving skills.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work within project deadlines and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* In this role, you'll contribute to the transformation of traditional construction practices by leveraging technology to improve project outcomes, reduce errors, enhance collaboration, and streamline construction processes.

 Experience: 6 Months\- 3 Years

 We are looking for a Junior Data Analytics Associate who is eager to build a career in data and retail analytics. * Some exposure to BI or reporting tools like Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
* Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to data handling.
* Good written and verbal communication skills — able to present simple findings clearly.
* Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced analytics consulting environment.


**Good To Have**

* Interest in promo analytics, merchandising, or pricing analysis.
* Basic awareness of Azure Databricks or cloud data platforms.
* Familiarity with Jira or any task management tool.

**Job Description**

**Role**

The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery


**͏**

**Do**

* Delivery Management
* Ensure seamless delivery of the projects
* Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement

* Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations

* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
* Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
* Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
* Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
* Delivery governance across the project
* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
* Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage

* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing
* Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
* Fresher engagement program
* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
* Team Management
* Resourcing
* Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
* Hire adequate and right resources for the team
* Talent Management
* Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
* Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization

  

* Manage team attrition
* Drive diversity in leadership positions
* Performance Management
* Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
* Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
* Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
* Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team

-----

The Field Agronomist represents CropMentor Technologies Pvt. Ltd. at the ground level. * **Contract Execution:** Facilitate the process of executing formal Contract Farming Agreements (including the buy\-back clause) with farmers.

* **Buy\-Back Assistance:** Assist the TM and RSM during harvest with quality verification and the final crop procurement process.

**C. Reporting and Administration**

* **Daily Reporting:** Provide detailed daily reports to the Territory Manager (TM) on farmer visits, sales progress, and the status of payments collected.
* **Record Maintenance:** Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of all sales transactions, farmer data, and contract copies.
* **Market Feedback:** Collect and communicate feedback to the TM regarding pricing, product performance, and farmer concerns in the market.

Graduation in any discipline or a Diploma in Agricultural Science.

**Location:** Vytilla, Kochi \| **Job Type:** Internship \| **Work Mode:** On\-site \| **Industry:** EdTech · Fintech · AI

**About Astra School**

Astra School is an edu\-fintech startup at the intersection of artificial intelligence and financial education. We're building the next generation of tools and learning experiences that make finance accessible, intelligent, and actionable. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about how our product looks and feels \- because great design is how our mission comes to life.

We're looking for a creative and driven **Graphic Designer Intern** to join our in\-office team and help shape the visual identity of Astra School across all our touchpoints.

**What You'll Do**

* Design high\-quality creatives for our mobile application and website \- including UI assets, banners, icons, and illustrations
* Create visually compelling marketing materials for webinars, social media campaigns, and digital ads
* Build pitch decks, presentation templates, and investor\-facing collateral
* Collaborate with the product and marketing teams to develop on\-brand visual content that communicates complex financial and AI concepts clearly
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines to ensure consistency across all platforms
* Support the design of landing pages, email newsletters, and promotional graphics
* Rapidly iterate on designs based on feedback in a fast\-paced startup environment

**What We're Looking For**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field
* A strong portfolio showcasing UI/UX design, digital creatives, or branding work *(portfolio submission required)*
* Proficiency in **Figma** and the **Adobe Creative Suite** (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
* Working knowledge of **Canva** for quick\-turnaround creatives
* A good eye for typography, color, and layout \- especially in digital\-first contexts
* Ability to translate abstract ideas (finance, AI, data) into clean and engaging visuals
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* Bonus: Experience with motion graphics, video editing (After Effects / Premiere Pro), or basic UI/UX prototyping

**What You Get**

* Hands\-on experience working directly with the founding team at a high\-growth AI and fintech startup
* Real ownership of design work that goes live on our app, website, and marketing channels
* A fast\-moving, collaborative in\-office environment where your ideas are heard and implemented
* Stipend provided
* Certificate of completion and a Letter of Recommendation
* Potential for a full\-time offer based on performance

**Who This Is For**

You're someone who obsesses over the details \- the spacing, the hierarchy, the color palette. You want real work experience at a startup, not a rigid corporate internship. You're comfortable working on\-site, collaborating in real time, and learning on the go. If fintech or AI excites you, even better.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and portfolio (Behance, Dribbble, or PDF) to **hr@astraschool.app.** Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Job Types: Contractual / Temporary, Fresher, Internship  
Contract length: 6 months

Pay: Up to ₹5,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Content Writer Intern
description:
**Content Writer Intern \- Astra School Pvt Ltd**

**Location:** Vytilla, Kochi \| **Job Type:** Internship \| **Work Mode:** On\-site \| **Industry:** EdTech · Fintech · AI

**About Astra School**

Astra School is an edu\-fintech startup on a mission to make financial literacy and AI\-driven finance education accessible to everyone. We sit at the intersection of finance and artificial intelligence \- building tools, content, and learning experiences that prepare the next generation for a financially intelligent future. If you want to be part of something that is being built from the ground up and actually see the impact of your work, this is the place.

**The Role**

We are looking for a creative, bilingual Content Writer Intern to join our core team in\-office. You will be writing content that lives inside our app, on our website, across our webinar sessions, and anywhere else our learners interact with us. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role where your words directly shape how people understand finance and AI.

**What You Will Do**

* Write clear, engaging content in both **Malayalam and English** for our mobile application, website, and marketing materials
* Create scripts, summaries, and promotional copy for webinars and live learning sessions
* Write and maintain website copy including landing pages, FAQs, and product descriptions
* Collaborate with the design and product team to ensure content is on\-brand and audience\-appropriate
* Assist in building and maintaining a content calendar
* Proofread and edit content for accuracy, clarity, and consistency across platforms

**Who We Are Looking For**

* Fluent in both **Malayalam and English \-** written proficiency in both is non\-negotiable
* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Finance, or a related field
* A genuine interest in **personal finance, financial literacy, or AI \-** you do not need to be an expert, but you need to be curious
* Strong research skills and the ability to simplify complex financial and technical topics
* Detail\-oriented with a good eye for grammar, tone, and clarity
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment with shifting priorities
* Available for a **full\-time, in\-office internship** in Kochi

**Nice to Have**

* Prior writing samples, a blog, or any published content (academic or personal)
* Basic familiarity with SEO or content management systems
* Experience writing for social media or digital platforms
* Interest in EdTech or FinTech

* Hands\-on experience building content from scratch at a real startup

* Exposure to the EdTech and FinTech industry at an early, exciting stage

* **Industry:** EdTech, FinTech, AI, Finance Education
* **Education:** Any graduate or final\-year student

title: Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) Business Analyst
description:
****Capgemini is seeking a skilled Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) Business Analyst to join our dynamic team.****
 The successful candidate will play a vital role in bridging business requirements and technology solutions within banking and financial services projects, particularly focusing on Temenos TAP implementations and enhancements. We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have experience working in TAP Wealth management solution. These roles represent a unique opportunity build your career as a Banking I.T. professional and gain further exposure to some of the world's top banking institutions.
   

  

 As a vital part of our business unit, you'll contribute to first\-class end\-to\-end solutions in your assignments. You will play an active role in defining our practices, standards and ways of working, and apply them to your role. Be open to working across organisation and team boundaries to ensure we bring the best to our customers.
   

  

 Our Banking and Diversified Financials practice helps clients shape, define and deliver banking transformation initiatives across the entire span of the organisation (front office to back office). This encompasses driving process improvement and process digitisation to enhance customer experience and delivery straight\-through digital processing and self\-service across the bank.
   

  

 Key areas of focus are around wealth management, payments, structured products and money market products. Working closely with clients, product owners, and technical teams, you will gather, analyze, and document business processes and requirements to ensure successful delivery of banking software solutions aligned with strategic goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities include:**
* Provision of specific TAP expertise to enable delivery teams
* Gather requirements from the Business and work, document them with work with the TAP technical teams to translate the end user requirements to application/system requirements
* Reviewing requirements documents provided by the clients
* Build customization on TAP solution using the TAP scripting language
* Performing code reviews, creating code review standards,
* Mentoring and guiding the developers to adhere to the coding standards
* Training the team members in TAP Business Analysis
* Configuring TAP GUI, TAP WUI, Financial Servers and eco\-system components like WTX / TTI / Actuate etc
* Expertise in configuring \& tailoring Strategies, Constraints, PTCC checks, Formats, Screens, Reports etc covering various F2B \& B2f processes for Asset classes Securities, derivatives, Forex products, structured products, forwards and spots, money market products
* Documenting functional specification and Test artefacts
* Expertise in preparing meaningful, concise and aesthetically pleasing power point presentations
* Conduct functional trainings on TAP
* Collaborate with partners within and outside Capgemini to build assets \& accelerators


**Requirements**
**Functional Skills:**
* Minimum 10\+ years' experience as a TAP WUI or GUI SME with a large organisation
* Minimum 5\+ years of non\-TAP experience, preferably in Wealth Management, acting as BA Lead for at least 2 years.
* Strong analysis skills with wealth expertise, possessing significant work experience and in\-depth knowledge of wealth products like securities, Bonds, Mutual Funds, Structured Products, Derivatives, Forex, forwards, spots etc
* Understand the Wealth Management and Private Banking business and eco system \- Custodian, Depository, Broker, Registrar etc
* Experience preparing good quality Functional Design/Technical specifications/Test cases
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum in particular and the use of Jira
* Able to work as Team player as well as independently without any supervision


**Soft Skills:**
* Strong client management skills
* Confident and articulate \- excellent verbal and communication skills
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Able to build relationship with business stakeholders and other team members
* Ability to lead a team


**Benefits**
 Competitive compensation and benefits package:
   

  

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Retirement Benefits
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Performance Bonus


 Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 59\-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22\.5 billion in revenues in 2025\.

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era.  Reporting to the Manager of Technical Documentation, you will work closely with a global network of engineers, product managers, and developer success professionals to understand real\-world use cases for identity and access management. You will create practical technical content that guides Oktas community of developers to adopt and deploy our solutions successfully.

* Design, develop, edit, and deliver accurate and effective developer documentation for Okta products.
* Work closely with Engineering, Product Management, QA, Support, and members of the Information Development team to ensure quality and accuracy of content.
* Follow our documentation guidelines to produce high quality documentation.
* Prioritize projects when working with multiple engineering teams.
* Collaborate with developers to review API documentation.
* Analyze customer feedback before and after delivering documentation to enhance content depth, quality, and relevance.

* Self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience writing SDK, CLI, or developer tools documentation.
* Experience writing developer documentation and release notes.
* Experience with Markdown, Visual Studio Code, Acrolinx, and source control tools such as Git and GitHub.
* Familiarity working with Jira and Confluence.
* Collaboration skills with other writers.


**And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!**
* Strong ability to understand the application of security products in the real world and produce use case\-based content.
* Knowledge of Okta or similar identity and access management solutions.

title: Junior Frontend Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About Plane**
 Plane is an incisive response to config\-heavy, opinionated, and restrictive project management software. Check out our website.
   

  

 In just two years, Plane’s grown to \#1 in its category on GitHub and become a viable open\-core alternative to Jira, Monday, Wrike, Asana, ClickUp, and Linear, not to mention all\-in\-one tools like Notion or Obsidian.
   

  

 Our growth has come on the back of the product’s true flexibility without artificial limits, simple configurations that work out of the box, and thoughtfully packaged features that nurture our customers’ growth instead of punishing it.
   

  

 As a modern product start\-up, we obsess over new and power users equally. Our mission is to empower teams everywhere with the simplest, most delightful work management experience on the planet. Our vision is to become the WorkOS of the future with a workbench of unified tools and techniques that intuitively and progressively form a greater whole for knowledge workers.
   

  

 We’re well capitalized, backed by OSS Capital, and are revenue\-positive. Our coworkers include ex\-Microsoft, Deloitte, \[24]7, Nutanix, and Yahoo! in our 50\+ strong human force today.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Were looking for a Junior Frontend Engineer who is early in their career but already shows real hunger for the craft of building software. This is a role for someone who wants to work on a product that thousands of teams rely on, learn from engineers who care deeply about quality, and grow quickly by taking on meaningful, well\-scoped problems.
   

  

 You wont just be picking up tickets. Youll contribute to real user\-facing features, pair with senior engineers on harder problems, and steadily take on more ownership as you grow. Our expectation is that within a year, youll be shipping features end\-to\-end with confidence.
   

  

 Youll work directly with designers, product managers, and other engineers in a tight feedback loop, and your work will reach hundreds of thousands of users and thousands of teams globally.
   

  

**What Youll Do**
* Build user\-facing features. Implement user\-facing features across our product, contributing to UI components, data models, and API integrations. Youll start with well\-scoped work and gradually take on larger, more ambitious surfaces as you grow.
* Contribute to our sync and real\-time collaboration layer. Work alongside senior engineers to help extend our data synchronization mechanism and collaborative editing tools, which use a local\-first architecture. Youll learn how modern sync engines, serialization, and conflict resolution actually work in production.
* Learn and apply browser\-level performance techniques. Get hands\-on with Service Workers and IndexedDB for caching, and contribute to making Plane feel fast on slow networks and functional when users are offline.
* Help push UI performance. Profile and optimize rendering paths — virtualization, memoization, selective re\-renders — guided by senior engineers and our performance goals. Complex, dense views are a core part of Plane, and keeping them smooth is a shared responsibility.
* Add instrumentation to what you ship. Help build out analytics, monitoring, and alerting around new features so the team can spot issues early. Youll learn to think about observability as part of shipping, not as an afterthought.
* Work with our TypeScript tooling and build pipeline. Get comfortable with Vite and Rolldown, and contribute to keeping our developer experience fast and our production bundles lean.
* Participate in our open\-source work. Plane is open\-source at its core. Youll contribute patches, review community PRs, and help us maintain a healthy public codebase.
* Grow into strong engineering habits. Write clear code, ask good questions in reviews, document your work, and adopt the testing and review practices of a senior engineering team from day one.


**What Youll Bring**
* 2–4 years of professional frontend experience, with a portfolio of work (production apps, side projects, or open\-source contributions) that shows you can ship real software.
* Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and React. Youre comfortable with modern React — hooks, component composition, context — and you write TypeScript with intent rather than just appeasing the compiler.
* Working understanding of routing and state management. Practical experience with React Router and at least one client\-side state management library (MobX, Redux, Zustand, or similar). You should be able to reason about when state belongs local vs. global and how reactivity flows through your app.
* Comfort writing modern CSS. You can build responsive, themeable UIs and are comfortable with utility\-first CSS (Tailwind) or a similar modern approach.
* Good instincts for design and UI details. You dont have to be a designer, but you should notice when something feels off — a misaligned element, a clumsy empty state, a jarring transition — and care enough to fix it.
* A curious, prototyping mindset. Youre the kind of engineer whod rather build a small, working version of an idea than argue about it in the abstract.
* Comfort working in a small, fast\-moving team. You can take ownership of a task, ask good clarifying questions, and drive it to completion without needing constant direction.
* Attention to detail and a craft mindset. You care about the small things — the empty states, the loading behavior, the micro\-interactions — because they add up to how the product feels.
* A learners attitude. Youre eager to pick up new tools, unafraid to ask questions, and open to feedback in code review and beyond.


**Nice to Have**
* Contributions to open\-source projects, even small ones.
* Exposure to rich\-text editor frameworks (ProseMirror, CodeMirror, Lexical, Tiptap).
* Familiarity with Service Workers, IndexedDB, or offline\-first app patterns.
* Experience with Electron or desktop app packaging.
* Prior experience on project management, productivity, or collaboration products.


**Our Tech Stack**
**Frontend**
* React with TailwindCSS, using hooks for composable functionality
* React Router for client\-side routing
* MobX for binding the data model to the UI
* ProseMirror\-based content editor
* Electron for the desktop application


**Backend \& Infrastructure**
* Django/Python, Golang, and Elixir services


**PostgreSQL** 
 and
 **Redis**
* Public REST and GraphQL APIs with full access to user data
* AWS Cloud with Kubernetes and Rancher


**Tooling \& Monitoring**
* Internal design system with a React component library
* Vite and Rolldown for build tooling
* DataDog and Sentry for observability
* GitHub, Slack, Plane, Figma, and Whimsical for day\-to\-day work


**Why Join Plane**
* Accelerate your growth. Work alongside senior engineers who genuinely enjoy mentoring and will invest in your development. Code reviews, pairing sessions, and architecture discussions are real learning moments here, not formalities.
* Ship work that matters. The features you build will be used by thousands of teams globally. Youll see the impact of your work in production within weeks of joining — not after months of onboarding.
* Learn the full stack of modern frontend. From local\-first sync to real\-time collaboration to performance at scale, Plane touches nearly every interesting problem in modern frontend engineering. Its a fast way to grow from "I can build features" to "I can design systems."
* Build in the open. Everything you ship lands in an open\-source codebase. Your GitHub contribution graph will reflect the real work youre doing — visible to the community and useful for your career.
* A culture of craft and kindness. We write things down, review each others work carefully, and treat questions — especially from new engineers — as a healthy sign of engagement.
* Room to grow into more. As you mature in the role, youll naturally take on bigger surfaces, more design input, and more ownership. We hire junior engineers expecting them to become senior engineers here.

title: HR Operations & Payroll Manager
description:
**About BrightCHAMPS** 




  





 BrightCHAMPS is a fast\-growing global edtech platform valued at $650M, delivering live, expert\-led learning in Coding, Robotics, Financial Literacy, Math, AI, and Communication to kids aged 6–16 across 30\+ countries and 12\+ languages. As we scale rapidly across geographies, we are building robust people operations infrastructure to support our growing workforce — and we're looking for seasoned HR leaders who can bring structure, rigour, and scale to our people operations.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a highly experienced and process\-driven
 **HR Operations \& Payroll Manager** 
 to own and strengthen our end\-to\-end HR operations, payroll processing, and statutory compliance functions. This is a senior leadership role for someone who has built and managed large\-scale HR operations, navigated complex compliance landscapes across geographies, and driven meaningful process transformation. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise across payroll systems, global compliance, HR analytics, and team leadership — and has a strong track record of managing HR operations for large, multi\-location workforces.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Payroll \& Statutory Compliance** 



* Own end\-to\-end payroll processing for 1500\+ employees across locations, ensuring 100% accuracy, timeliness, and statutory adherence
* Manage all statutory compliance obligations — PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, Form 16, and IT Declarations — in close coordination with the global compliance team
* Oversee Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements, ensuring prompt processing in line with company policy and applicable labour laws
* Lead statutory audits, filings, and reconciliations; serve as the primary interface for internal and external auditors
* Partner with global compliance teams to align cross\-border payroll and HR practices with regional regulatory requirements
* Act as the liaison with outstation HR teams, local staff, and payroll providers to conclude country payrolls.
* Review and validate payroll calculations received from external payroll consultants.



  





**HR Operations \& Systems** 



* Manage, configure, and continuously optimize HRIS and payroll platforms — Zoho Payroll, Keka, and DarwinBox — ensuring data integrity and system efficiency
* Lead full\-cycle payroll system implementations, including planning, data migration, validation, UAT, and go\-live
* Maintain rigorous headcount reconciliation across departments, cost centres, locations, and business units
* Oversee structured onboarding workflows ensuring a compliant, consistent, and positive experience for all new joiners
* Draft, review, and periodically update HR policies in alignment with business needs, legal frameworks, and best practices



  





**MIS, Analytics \& Budgeting** 



* Design and publish MIS reports and payroll analytics dashboards for HR leadership, finance, and business heads
* Manage HR budgets, headcount cost tracking, and payroll variance analysis; proactively flag risks and drive cost control
* Build and automate reporting frameworks using Advanced Excel and HRIS tools to improve accuracy and reduce manual effort
* Deliver data\-driven insights on workforce trends, attrition, and cost movements to support strategic decision\-making



  





**Team Leadership \& Process Excellence** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the HR operations team — setting clear goals, building capability, and driving high performance
* Identify and execute process improvement and automation initiatives across payroll, compliance, and HR operations
* Serve as the senior escalation point for employee queries related to payroll, benefits, compliance, and HR processes
* Foster a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* **10–15 years** 
 of progressive experience in HR operations and payroll management, with significant exposure to global compliance teams and multi\-geography workforces
* Demonstrated experience managing end\-to\-end payroll and HR operations for a workforce of 1500\+ employees
* Understanding of payroll cycles, payroll accounting entries, and statutory deductions.
* Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure, and Follows defined SOPs and guidelines with discipline.
* Understanding in Indian statutory compliance — PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, Form 16, and Labour Law adherence
* Hands\-on, advanced proficiency with HRIS and payroll platforms —
 **Zoho Payroll, Keka, and DarwinBox** 
 — including system implementation and migration experience
* Expertise in F\&F settlement processing, onboarding design, and HR policy drafting and review
* Proficiency in Advanced Excel; demonstrated ability to build MIS frameworks and payroll analytics reports
* Proven leadership experience managing and developing HR operations teams
* Strong analytical mindset, high attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a high\-growth environment
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — comfortable engaging with finance, legal, and business leadership



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with multi\-country or international payroll processing
* Exposure to HR process automation tools and HRIS integrations
* Prior experience in a high\-growth startup, edtech, or technology\-driven organization
* Familiarity with budgeting tools and workforce cost modelling



  





**Why BrightCHAMPS** 



* Be part of a mission\-driven global company impacting millions of learners across 30\+ countries
* Senior, high\-ownership role with direct visibility to CHRO and business leadership
* Fast\-paced, collaborative culture with real scope to build, automate, and transform HR operations
* Competitive compensation, strong benefits, and a meaningful growth trajectory

description:

 JOB TITLE: HR Officer
 



 POSITION REPORTS TO: Senior Manager \- Human Resources, HQ
 



 EMPLOYMENT BASIS: Fulltime
 



 LOCATION: Global
 



 TIME COMMITMENT: Monday\-Friday; 40 hr week
 



  





**ROLE DESCRIPTION** 




 ATEC exists to decarbonise cooking for all households across the Global South with our patented IoT eCook stoves. 4 billion people across Asia \& Africa still lack access to modern cooking \- generating 1 gigaton of emissions, more than the global airline industry. * Tracks compliance deadlines and policy acknowledgements
* Supports audits and documentation requests
* In collaboration with HRM reviews and updates HR policies

* Administers engagement surveys
* Coordinates training sessions and workshops
* Tracks participation and learning completion
* Manages recognition program logistics
* Collects feedback and prepares reports



  





 4\.Employee Relations
 


* Handles routine ER matters
* Documents cases and maintains records
* Supports investigation processes
* Escalates high\-risk matters



  





 5\.Performance Management
 


* Administers performance review cycle
* Tracks completion rates
* Prepares documentation for PIPs
* Monitors deadlines and compliance
* Administers employee benefits processes



  





 6\.Global HR Initiatives \& Projects

* Assists with HR systems implementation logistics
* Tracks rollout milestones
* Supports communication of new policies and processes



  





 Other duties as delegated by the line Manager.
 



  





**SELECTION CRITERIA** 




  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** 



* degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in Google Workspace as well as MS Office suite
* At least 3 years’ experience running end\-to\-end HR functions (recruitment, onboarding, performance management) in a mission\-driven or impact\-focused organization.
* High level of confidentiality and professionalism
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team



  





**PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES** 



* Alignment with ATEC’s core values of One Team, Continuous Learning \& Goal\-Orientated
* Enjoy working in a fast paced and distributed startup/scaleup work environment
* Comfortable with rapid iteration
* High attention to detail
* Resolute in using your skills and experience to make the strongest possible impact in the world

title: Image Analyst (QA/QC)
description:
**1\. Role Summary**

 The Image Analyst will be a critical member of the Data Operations team, responsible for the rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) of GalaxEye's cutting\-edge Earth Observation (EO) data products. This role involves hands\-on analysis of raw and processed SAR, MSI, and OptoSAR data to ensure they meet the highest standards of radiometric, geometric, and thematic accuracy before delivery to customers.
   





 This position is offered on a contractual basis. Subject to business requirements and individual performance, the contract role may be considered for conversion to a full\-time position through the company’s standard evaluation process. The selected candidate should also be willing to work on a shift basis, as required by project and operational needs.
   




**2\. Key Responsibilities**

 The primary focus of this role is the meticulous analysis and validation of Earth Observation data products:
   

  




**A. Quality Assurance and Control (QA/QC)**

 ●
 **Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Data:**




 ○ Perform visual and quantitative inspection of SAR imagery to detect artifacts, calibration issues, or geometric distortions.
   





 ●
 **Multi\-Spectral (MSI) and Data:**




 ○ Execute QC checks on optical data for cloud cover, haze, sensor noise, and atmospheric correction performance.
   





 ○ Verify band\-to\-band registration accuracy (alignment of spectral bands).
   





 ○ Assess the quality of orthorectification and geometric precision against reference maps.
   





 ●
 **SyncFused (SAR \+ MSI Fusion) Products:**




 ○ Critically analyze the fused output to ensure seamless integration coherence between the SAR and optical components.
   





 ○ Identify and document any artifacts introduced during the fusion process.
   





 ●
 **Process Management:**




 ○ Utilize and contribute to internal software tools and automated scripts for daily QC monitoring and metric generation.
   





 ○ Maintain detailed QA/QC logs and databases of product anomalies, processing errors, and correction status.
   

  




**B. Documentation and Collaboration**

 ● Collaborate closely with the Data Processing Engineers and Calibration/Validation (Cal/Val) teams to understand and resolve identified data anomalies.
   





 ● Prepare detailed data quality reports for product batches, summarizing key performance metrics and highlighting any necessary reprocessing steps.
   





 ● Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA/QC protocols and standards.
   




**3\. Qualifications and Skills**
**Required Qualifications (Entry\-Level/Fresher Friendly)**

 ●
 **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geophysics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related analytical field.
   





 ●
 **Core Knowledge:** 
 Foundational understanding of Earth Observation principles, basic image processing techniques, and coordinate systems/geodesy.
   





 ●
 **Software Proficiency:** 
 Practical experience with industry\-standard GIS and remote sensing software (like QGIS, ArcGIS, SNAP, ENVI) for image manipulation and analysis.

description:
Webflow Developer
 



 Full\-Time · Remote · Immediate Start · ₹35,000/month
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 TabTech is a lean, fast\-moving branding and design agency serving funded startups and B2B businesses. We help Pressure\-Cooker Founders — post\-seed operators under real pressure — avoid brand disasters and ship enterprise\-grade design at startup speed and budget.
 



  





 We're looking for a No\-Code Developer who can move fast, build clean, and never complain about timelines. If you live in Webflow and Shopify, know JavaScript well enough to bend no\-code to your will, and get genuinely excited about AI\-assisted development — this role was written for you.
 



  





 You'll be working directly on client projects from day one. No hand\-holding. No long ramp\-ups. Just real work, real clients, and real ownership.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





 → Build and ship Webflow sites with pixel\-perfect accuracy, responsive layouts, and clean CMS architecture
 



  





 → Own Shopify store maintenance end\-to\-end — app management, theme updates, product/collection setup, bug fixes, and keeping stores running smoothly for clients
 



  





 → Use prompt engineering to handle Shopify customizations that would otherwise need deep Liquid knowledge — generating, debugging, and adapting code with AI tools confidently
 



  





 → Write JavaScript to extend and customize no\-code tools beyond their default capabilities
 



  





 → Collaborate directly with designers to implement brand systems and design specifications
 



  





 → Manage multiple client projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or timelines
 



  





 → Own post\-launch support, QA, and iterative improvements based on client feedback

 → Fresher or up to 1 year of experience — we care about what you've built, not how long you've been doing it
 



  





 → Hands\-on experience with Webflow — CMS, interactions, and custom code injections (personal projects, freelance work, or coursework all count)
 



  





 → Shopify store management familiarity — app installs/configs, theme edits, product management, and store operations
 



  





 → Strong prompt engineering skills — you know how to use AI tools to generate and debug Liquid snippets, write custom JavaScript, and solve edge cases without being a Liquid expert yourself
 



  





 → Solid JavaScript fundamentals — DOM manipulation, async/await, APIs, and the ability to debug your own code
 



  





 → Proven use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as a core part of your workflow — not occasionally, but habitually
 



  





 → Ability to read a design file and ship it accurately — no "close enough" mentality
 



  





 → Self\-starter who manages their own time, flags blockers early, and doesn't wait to be chased
 



  





**GOOD TO HAVE** 




  





 → Basic Liquid knowledge — not required, but a plus for when AI\-generated code needs a human sanity check
 



  





 → Experience with Framer — bonus if you've shipped production sites
 



  





 → Familiarity with Supabase, FlutterFlow, or other no\-code/low\-code tools
 



  





 → Basic understanding of SEO, Core Web Vitals, and page performance
 



  





 → CRM integrations (HubSpot, Mailchimp, etc.) → Any exposure to design tools — Figma comfort goes a long way
 



  





**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 → Agency\-minded — you understand that client work is service work, and quality is non\-negotiable
 



  





 → Hungry to learn — you're actively exploring new tools, new AI workflows, and pushing the limits of no\-code
 



  





 → Communicator — you give clear updates, ask the right questions, and never go silent when things get hard
 



  





 → Problem\-solver first — when something doesn't work, you figure it out before escalating
 



  





 → Proud of your craft — sloppy output isn't in your vocabulary
 



  





**WHAT YOU GET** 




 → ₹30,000/month fixed compensation
 



  





 → Work directly with the founder on real client projects — no busywork, no filler tasks
 



  





 → Exposure to a diverse range of projects: funded startups, B2B brands, enterprise clients
 



  





 → A culture that values speed, quality, and learning — not politics or meetings
 



  





 → Room to grow into a senior technical role as TabTech scales
 



  





 → Flexible remote setup with a team that respects your time and delivers on its promises

Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
   

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
   

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
 



 \- Client Relationship Management
   

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients
   

 \- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
 



 \- Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
 



 \- Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
   

 \- Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
   

 \- Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
   

 \- Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
 


 ͏
 
 \- Operational Excellence
   

 \- Automation Focus
   

 \- Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
   

 \- Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
 



  

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
 



 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team

 \- Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
   

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team

 Deliver

 PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ operational efficiency
   

  
   

 Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects

 Course description
   

  

 Career Counseling is a process that will help you to know and understand yourself and the world of work in order to make career, educational, and life decisions. Career development is more than just deciding on a major and what job you want to get when you graduate.
   

  

 Career Counsellors are experts at assessing your aptitude, personality, interests, and other aspects. They use this evaluation to suggest the best career options from all the available and relevant options. Career Counselling provides access to the resources and knowledge that a career expert possesses.
   

  

 The end of middle school is often considered the threshold of the career foundation. And once middle school finishes, there is a new sense of responsibility that the students feel. They start considering strengthening their focus and concentration on subjects like Science and Maths. They actively start observing their peers and start getting influenced by career discussions with them.
   

  

 Parents, by now, are more serious about the performance of a child as the career\-building stage effectively starts from this very point in life. It’s at this tender age that a student should enroll themselves in a session of career counseling in India. Given that the seeds of ‘success in the future are sown during this time, this is the best opportunity to educate the students about the importance of career planning. It’s relatively easier to expose them to the plethora of career choices post recognizing their skills and talent and helping them get their life on track from the very beginning.

title: L1+ Network Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM Infrastructure \& Technology, we design and operate the systems that keep the world running. From high\-resiliency mainframes and hybrid cloud platforms to networking, automation, and site reliability. Our teams ensure the performance, security, and scalability that clients and industries depend on every day. Working in Infrastructure \& Technology means tackling complex challenges with curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies and colleagues worldwide to deliver resilient, future\-ready solutions that power innovation. With continuous learning, career growth, and a supportive culture, IBM provides the opportunities to build expertise and shape the infrastructure that drives progress.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
* Will be responsible for monitoring and maintaining all network


 devices/links at the data centres/ disaster recovery sites
   

  

* Fault Management for Network related issues at DC/DR/NDR


 site : trouble ticket initiation, follow up problems till resolution and
   

  

 escalation (if required)
   

  

* Perform network related changes on network devices as per


 role and accessibility defined in SOP issued by the bank
   

  

* share daily report of device health status and configuration


 changes from the tool used by the bank
   

  

* share reports on any alarms/events in all network devices in


 data centres
   

  

* Provide inputs to L2 engineers for issue resolution, consulting,


 IT infrastructure planning and change management.
   

  

* Escalate the issue to L2 engineer in case issue not resolved
* Coordinate with Data Centre team for issue resolution and


 activities
   

  

* Maintain the inventory of network devices of DC/DR Network
* Participate in DR Drills
* Any Other work assigned by bank regarding network
* should be able to do cabling work for DC, DR \& NDR (like


 crimping / cable routing etc.)
   

  

* Co\-ordinate with service providers
* Should keep updated Architecture diagram of DC/DR including


 LAN ports details
   

  

 Valid CCNA/JNCIA Routing and Switching or equivalent
   

  

 associate level certifications.
   

  

**Preferred Education**
 Associate's Degree/College Diploma
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Exposure to Networking Products: Familiarity with installation, maintenance, and repair of Networking products, such as Cisco, Juniper, Levella , DELL and Radware devices
* Understanding of Technology and Software: Knowledge of operating systems, associated software, and the functions and capabilities of Networking equipment.
* Experience with Technical Support Tools: Familiarity with IBM tools, such as Cognitive Support Platform (Salesforce) and Watson Einstein Analytics, to drive automation and improve effectiveness of client operations.
* Basic Understanding of IT Engineering: Knowledge in areas of installation, customization, operation, recovery, tuning, and information technology engineering.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Familiarity with IT Service Management: Exposure to IT service management principles and practices, including problem and incident management, is beneficial for this role.

title: CORE NETWORKING-ROUTING & SWITCHING- EXTREME
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
**Job Title: Network Engineer – Ubiquiti, Meraki, and Cisco Routing \& Switching, Aruba wireless**
****Role Summary:****
 Responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining network infrastructure leveraging Ubiquiti, Cisco Meraki, and Cisco routing and switching technologies. The role includes managing firewalls, wireless solutions, and ensuring secure, high\-performance connectivity across enterprise environments.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities:****
 Configure and manage Ubiquiti EdgeRouters, UniFi switches, and Meraki MX routers, MS switches, and MR wireless access points.
   

  

 Deploy and maintain Meraki firewalls and Cisco routing/switching infrastructure.
   

  

 Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity issues across multiple platforms.
   

  

 Configure and monitor routing protocols like OSPF, BGP.
   

  

 Implement VLANs, QoS, STP, trunking, and inter\-VLAN routing.
   

  

 Utilize Meraki Dashboard and UniFi Controller for network monitoring and optimization.
   

  

 Ensure network security and compliance with organizational policies.
   

  

 Perform firmware upgrades, backup configurations, and maintain documentation.
   

  

****Required Skills:****
 Strong knowledge of Ubiquiti routing and switching hardware.
   

  

 Expertise in Cisco Meraki products and cloud\-managed networking.
   

  

 Proficiency in Cisco IOS commands and Layer 2 technologies.
   

  

 Familiarity with VPN, VLAN, firewall configurations, and QoS.
   

  

 Ability to troubleshoot complex network issues across multi\-vendor environments.
   

  

****Certifications:****
* Cisco certifications (CCNA/CCNP) and Meraki CMNA certification preferred.
* Ubiquiti certification (UEWA or similar) is a plus.


****Experience:****
* Minimum 5 years of experience in network engineering with Ubiquiti, Meraki, and Cisco technologies
